name: DiscStubHider
description: Disc Stub Hider watches your library for folders that contain both a Jellyfin .disc placeholder (used for physical DVD/Blu-ray entries) and an actual video file (.strm, .mkv, .mp4, .avi, .mov, .wmv). When both are found, it renames the .disc stub to .disc.bak so Jellyfin no longer displays the placeholder, letting the real video take over playback. If the video is later removed, the stub is automatically restored so the disc placeholder reappears.
overview: Hides .disc stub files once a real video is present, and restores them if it's removed

versions.changelog: Version aligned to 1.0.0.0. Redesigned the plugin settings page with a themed, card-based layout matching Jellyfin's active theme colors, and the version shown on the settings page now tracks the running assembly version.
